title: Precedent: away from the desk
summary: Answering safely from your phone. What each does, and what we'd borrow (the cards that borrow it are in brackets).

checks.text: GitHub Mobile and Duo push: Approve a deployment or a sign-in from the lock screen; the server only passes the message along. We borrow: lock-screen answers (Away from home: what carries a c…; Answer from the notification)
Signal: A push says almost nothing; the phone fetches and decrypts the message itself. We borrow: sealed rows and a push that only gives a count (Away from home: what carries a c…)

why: Both answer the question of how to approve something from your phone without trusting the server in the middle, which is the hard part of Away from the Mac.

options.label: Looks right
options.then: Keep these as the models the cards cite, and build to them.

options.label: One's wrong for us
options.sub: say which, and why, in the note
